The CSS background-size Property

The
background-size property allows you to specify the size of background images.

The background size can be specified in lengths, percentages, or by using one of the
keywords: auto, contain,
or cover.

blocks.text: background-size - auto, contain and cover

The keyword values for
background-size are
auto, contain
and cover.

The auto value is the default value, and
displays the background image in its original size.
The contain value scales the image up or down, to fit inside the content area.

The cover value scales the image to be as large as possible so that the content area is
completely covered by the background image (its width and height will be equal to, or
larger than the content area).
